```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, nlme, CorrMixed, lme4, lmerTest, geepack, ggplot2, geomtextpath, car, emmeans, effectsize, simr, matrixStats, haven) # pacman is a package manager for R (!!! useful). Install packages if missing and load them
```

```{r cars}
# EEG feats

path_to_savefile = "/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new_relpower/rr_results/Means_SD_relpower.txt"
sink(path_to_savefile)

data_eo <- read.table("/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new_relpower/rr_data/EO_relpower_behavbl.csv", header=T, sep=",")
data_ec <- read.table("/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new_relpower/rr_data/EC_relpower_behavbl.csv", header=T, sep=",")

data_eo_ot_all<-data_eo[data_eo$Drug==1,]
data_eo_pl_all<-data_eo[data_eo$Drug==2,]

data_ec_ot_all<-data_ec[data_ec$Drug==1,]
data_ec_pl_all<-data_ec[data_ec$Drug==2,]

# EO
print("EO, Oxytocin, Theta-Alpha-Beta; means")
print(colMeans(data_eo_ot_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")], na.rm = TRUE))
print("EO, Oxytocin, Theta-Alpha-Beta; sd")
print(colSds(as.matrix(data_eo_ot_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")]), na.rm = TRUE))

print("EO, Placebo, Theta-Alpha-Beta; means")
print(colMeans(data_eo_pl_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")], na.rm = TRUE))
print("EO, Placebo, Theta-Alpha-Beta; sd")
print(colSds(as.matrix(data_eo_pl_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")]), na.rm = TRUE))

# EC
print("EC, Oxytocin, Theta-Alpha-Beta; means")
print(colMeans(data_ec_ot_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")], na.rm = TRUE))
print("EC, Oxytocin, Theta-Alpha-Beta; sd")
print(colSds(as.matrix(data_ec_ot_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")]), na.rm = TRUE))

print("EC, Placebo, Theta-Alpha-Beta; means")
print(colMeans(data_ec_pl_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")], na.rm = TRUE))
print("EC, Placebo, Theta-Alpha-Beta; sd")
print(colSds(as.matrix(data_ec_pl_all[,c("Theta","Alpha","Beta")]), na.rm = TRUE))

# double-check numbers for baselines
# EO

print("BASELINES: Oxytocin, Theta-Alpha-Beta; means ")
print(colMeans(data_eo_ot_all[,c("Theta_base","Alpha_base","Beta_base")], na.rm = TRUE))
print("BASELINES: Oxytocin, Theta-Alpha-Beta; sd ")
print(colSds(as.matrix(data_eo_ot_all[,c("Theta_base","Alpha_base","Beta_base")]), na.rm = TRUE))

print("BASELINES: Placebo, Theta-Alpha-Beta; means ")
print(colMeans(data_eo_pl_all[,c("Theta_base","Alpha_base","Beta_base")], na.rm = TRUE))
print("BASELINES: Placebo, Theta-Alpha-Beta; sd ")
print(colSds(as.matrix(data_eo_pl_all[,c("Theta_base","Alpha_base","Beta_base")]), na.rm = TRUE))

sink()

```
